# miniz

Amalgamated miniz sources vendored from the local wtffw dependency copy.
The embedded source identifies miniz 3.0.0; its zlib compatibility version is
independent of that version. USF builds disable ZIP, stdio and zlib aliases.

Original miniz.c SHA-256: `9912e2394970dfbd4259e60a40a63bde289692bcf764286d0d332620c78bc678`
Original miniz.h SHA-256: `28949a75d9a95d60d373674bdf1cac5cd8377f8802a4651e5b42d51c2fc143b3`

The vendored copy uses BSD 3-Clause notices with original copyright attributions.
